edits.text: Confidential Settlement Agreement and Mutual Release of Claims between Harrow and Delmar.
edits.name: title

edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims and disputes between them without admission of liability, and to memorialize the terms of that resolution in this Agreement.
edits.name: recitals

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the Settlement Amount set out below within ten (10) business days after execution of this Agreement, subject to any mutually agreed wire instructions and standard processing requirements.
edits.name: payment

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount, Plaintiff releases and forever discharges Defendant and its present and former affiliates, officers, directors, employees, agents, insurers, successors, and assigns from all claims, demands, causes of action, and liabilities of any kind, known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the matters at issue in this dispute.
edits.name: release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential, except that disclosure is permitted to counsel, tax advisors, immediate family members, and as required by law, court order, or subpoena, provided that any permitted recipient is informed of and agrees to maintain confidentiality to the fullest extent practicable.
edits.name: confidentiality

edits.text: 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability, wrongdoing, or fault by any party, and neither this Agreement nor the fact of settlement may be used as evidence except to enforce its terms.
edits.name: no_admission

edits.text: 5. DISMISSAL. Within five (5) business days after payment clears, the parties shall file or cause to be filed a stipulated dismissal of the action with prejudice, each side to bear its own fees and costs unless otherwise agreed in writing.
edits.name: dismissal

edits.text: 6. NON-DISPARAGEMENT. The parties agree not to make any false, disparaging, or misleading statements about one another concerning the subject matter of this dispute, subject to the same legal disclosure exceptions set forth above.
edits.name: non_disparagement
